name: @pipeworx/mcp-statbank-md

tools.name: subjects
tools.description: Navigate the database/subject tree. Root (empty path) lists databases ({dbid}). Drill into a database id to get folders (type "l") and tables (type "t", ".px" suffix).

path.description: Sub-path under /en/ (default empty = root database list). First segment is a database id, e.g. "20 Populatia si procesele demografice/POP010/POPro".

tools.name: table_meta
tools.description: Fetch dimension definitions and valid coded values for a Moldova Statbank PxWeb table. Path must end in the '.px' table id (e.g. '20 Populatia si procesele demografice/POP010/POPro/POP010100rcl.px'). Returns dimensions with codes and value lists — use these to build the selection body for query_table.

tools.name: query_table
tools.description: POST a PxWeb query to a Moldova National Bureau of Statistics (Statbank) table and return observations as json-stat2. body must be {query:[{code, selection:{filter,values}}], response:{format:'json-stat2'}}. PxWeb caps responses at ~10,000 cells — narrow each dimension's values using codes from table_meta.

path.description: Path ending in the ".px" table id.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-statbank-md forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the statbank-md pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
